### Automated Modernization Code Specification (PySpark)

Here is the clean, idempotent **PySpark DataFrame** transformation script generated from the ADF schema:

```python
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp, to_date

# Initialize Spark Session
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName('PIE_Modernized_Pipeline').getOrCreate()

# Read from Source
df_source = spark.read.format('parquet').load('abfss://raw@datalake.dfs.core.windows.net/stage/')

# Apply Transformations & Schema Validation
df_transformed = df_source \
    .filter(col('IsActive') == True) \
    .withColumn('IngestedAt', current_timestamp())

# Idempotent Merge / Write to Delta Lake
df_transformed.write.format('delta').mode('append').save('abfss://curated@datalake.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/')
```
